errors.text_span: The vertical axis is labeled "effect" and displays values ranging from 0 to 30 on a linear scale
errors.evidence: The vertical axis actually ranges from 0 to 40, not 30, as shown in the figure.

errors.text_span: There are three model types represented: mBERT-L2, XLM-L2, and mBERT-B2, each associated with a distinct color; mBERT-L2 is light green, XLM-L2 is light blue, and mBERT-B2 is red
errors.evidence: The figure includes six model types: mBERT-L₂ (light blue), XLM-L₂ (dark blue), mBERT-R₂ (light green), XLM-R₂ (dark green), mBERT-B₂ (pink), and XLM-B₂ (red). The description incorrectly states only three model types and misassigns colors.

errors.text_span: For each language family, there are three bars representing each model type, displayed side-by-side
errors.evidence: The figure shows up to six bars per language family, not three, corresponding to six model types.
The description does not explain the purpose of the chart, which is to illustrate the effect of different models on various language families.
The description does not mention the nominal scale of the horizontal axis or the tick intervals of the vertical axis.
The description omits the presence of error bars, which indicate variability within the model effects for each language family.
The description does not mention the legend in the top right corner, which identifies the model types and their corresponding colors.
The description does not mention the approximate values for specific language families, such as IE-Indic (17–23), Semitic (-8 to 20), and Uralic (mostly below 5).

errors.text_span: The horizontal axis represents language families, labeled as IE-Indic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly lists IE-Indic twice and omits IE-Baltic, which is present in the figure.
